title: Build the diffstat unified-diff statistics tool from its sealed spec
goal: Implement the diffstat library plus CLI exactly as written in assets/gc-402/SPEC.md, from scratch, at workspace/gc-402/diffstat.py. The spec demands genuine hunk-count tracking from @@ headers (so removed lines whose content begins with dashes are never mistaken for file headers), git rename and binary handling, /dev/null path resolution, and tab-separated timestamp stripping for classic diffs. Naive line-prefix scanners fail the sealed suite; plan the block/hunk state machine first, implement, and iterate on failures until green.
process_expectations: A plan artifact workspace/gc-402/plan.md exists before implementation, sketching the parser state machine (blocks, headers, hunk counters) and listing the trap cases from the spec.
workspace/gc-402/runs.log contains every sealed-suite invocation with summary lines; at least one intermediate RED run and the final GREEN run.
Failure identities tracked: each failing test node id mapped to the parsing rule it exposed and the code change that fixed it.
Recovery after RED documented as diagnosis -> fix -> re-run; the sealed test file is never modified.
